csv_project_name: Conslt for Multiple Service Agreements for Environmental Svc
csv_scope_of_work: Los Angeles World Airports (LAWA) is issuing this Request for Qualifications ( RFQ ) to solicit Statements of Qualifications ( SOQ ) from qualified firms ( Respondents ) to prequalify three Benches of on-call services related to environmental, sustainability, energy, and planning services as described in Section 5. These Benches are intended to select qualified environmental firms to provide as-needed professional services to support LAWA s ongoing and anticipated environmental, sustainability, energy, and planning needs via competitive Task Order Solicitation (TOS) procurements.
